authored: This file declares the SHAPE of a format and the surprises a reader has to survive. It contains nothing taken from anybody's file. Sample files are generated from it by scripts/generate-intake-fixture.mjs, and their content is invented.
literalUse: FORMAT DISCRIMINATOR. The entry name, class names and property names below are the tokens a reader must match to locate anything in a serialised object graph; they are the same ones the adapter carries. No template name, section name, item name or rating word from any real file appears in this repository.

quirks.statement: The rating vocabulary is defined by whoever authored the template. Two templates may share every word, some words, or none, so no word may be given a meaning by the reader.
quirks.measuredNote: Restated 2026-08-24. The earlier wording said 'three, four and five entries were observed, sharing no words'; measured against the corpus, every template declares exactly five, and while a bare majority of template pairs share no word, nearly half share at least one. The property that matters -- that the words are the author's and not a fixed set -- survives; the two numbers attached to it did not.

quirks.statement: The rating vocabulary may be absent entirely, and a reader must have an answer for a template that declares none.
quirks.measuredNote: ⚠️ DECLARED, NEVER SEEN. The earlier wording said absence was 'common rather than exceptional' on the strength of 8 of 22; re-measured 2026-08-24 with two instruments, it is 0 of 22. The reader's fallback for this case is therefore exercised by no real file. Keep the fallback -- a format that permits it will eventually produce it -- but do not read the fallback's passing tests as evidence anybody has met one.

quirks.statement: A vocabulary entry may carry leading or trailing whitespace that is part of the value.

A boolean property may be absent rather than false, and absent is the more common case. It may also be present as a REFERENCE to something else in the document rather than as a value, which a reader that does not resolve references cannot tell from absent.
quirks.measuredNote: Measured 2026-08-24: absent in 13 of 22, present as a literal in 8, present as a reference in 1. Every literal is false and none is true, so nothing in the corpus turns the flag on -- which means the 'on' branch downstream has never been driven by a real file either.

quirks.statement: A property may hold a back-reference to an object defined elsewhere in the document instead of a value. Some of those targets are not stored values at all but the result of reading another property, which cannot be resolved without executing the graph -- and this reader never executes anything. Such a property is reported as absent.
quirks.measuredNote: Added 2026-08-24. Measured, not assumed, and nothing had recorded it: 15 of 22 templates use references, 713 uses in total. It is the reason 'absent' has to be understood as 'this reader has no value', not as 'the file said nothing'.

quirks.statement: A document may carry no version. Two different things in these files can be called one -- the attribute the document opens with, and a property inside the graph -- and a claim about 'the version' has to say which.
quirks.measuredNote: ⚠️ DECLARED, NEVER SEEN as stated. Re-measured 2026-08-24: the opening attribute is present on 22 of 22, the property is absent on 9 of 22, and the recorded 21 of 22 matches neither. The old note's second half -- that the values span many years -- does hold of the attribute. Nothing in the reader branches on either, which is how a number nobody used stayed wrong.

quirks.statement: The archive may hold anything alongside the structure entry; entry counts from single digits to dozens were observed.
A template may declare no sections and no items at all, and such a file is legitimate.

A panel may contain another panel, so the format permits a level of structure below the item. The reader does NOT preserve it: `objectsOfClass` keeps scanning inside a matched object -- without which a section would yield one item however many it holds -- so an inner panel is returned as a sibling of its parent and the level is erased.
quirks.measuredNote: ⚠️ DECLARED, NEVER MEASURED. No template in the corpus has been checked for panel-inside-panel nesting and no depth statistic was ever recorded for any of them, so the manifest carries a null hash rather than a notObserved: nobody has looked. The adapter now emits a warning when it reads this shape, which is the honest half of the fix; preserving the level needs a real three-level file first.
